card.name: Linking words before co-use warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or", "If" and "When" (also "concom|itant") in warnings about using a drug together with alcohol, other depressants or interacting drugs. It fires right where a co-use or conditional clause begins.

modes.label: "or" after alcohol
modes.description: The word "or" right after "alcohol" or "beverages", leading into other sedating drugs or products.
